title: Xona’s commercial GPS alternative is about to go live
snippet: Xona's precision timing and navigation service will enter beta testing after SpaceX launches six satellites designed by the company.

title: President Trump awards Big Tech donors with nation’s highest science prizes
snippet: Together, the awardees have donated nearly $6 billion to efforts tied to Trump and his administration.

title: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
snippet: With over a thousand emails, slides, texts, and documents from the United States v. Elizabeth Holmes trial, Extend engineer Bo Lau created a website that simulates what it might have been like to rifle through the Theranos founder's desk.
